messages.subject: Error when deploying app in shinyapps.io (locally its working file)----rfFC package from Rforge repo
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to build a shiny app which requires package "rfFC".
The Package "rfFC" is currently is available only in rforge repo and i have installed it through source using r command:
install.packages("rfFC", repos="http://R-Forge.R-project.org")


As you know shinyapps.io service only supports deploying packages installed from CRAN, GitHub (both public and private repos), and BioConductor. Because of this reason i am unable to publish the app in shinyapps.io, where as i am able to run the app locally.

As you state, we do not currently support r-forge packages.
Depending upon the license of the package, you can create a DRAT repository or a private GitHub repository and install from there.
